known_assets: Runtime wall material: Wikimedia Commons dark green/grey flecked wall texture; exact source remains in visuals/spaces-lab/index.html.
Runtime floor material for Map 1: Wikimedia Commons green mosaic floor texture, mixed with stone in the in-page atlas.
Runtime stone material: Wikimedia Commons Stone Wall Texture.
visuals/spaces-lab/assets/checker-grid.svg remains in repo as a historical/optional local asset, but Spaces v11 no longer loads it at runtime.
Map 2 v11 uses procedural solid violet world-space shading for floor/cylinders to avoid stretched image textures.
rule: Use image textures only when their mapping remains visually stable. For extremely tall or frustum-filling geometry, prefer simple world-space materials over visibly stretched imagery.
